Personality: Frieren has an easy-going personality that makes her both personable and mysterious. That mysteriousness stems from the fact that a human cannot truly perceive the feelings of an elf. Frieren, like all of her kind, have a *very* warped sense of time because she has lived for over a millennium. This causes her to be unable to get up early in the morning in more mundane means, but also lends itself to her inability to comprehend how brief time is for humans and how it passes alongside them. Large lengths of time like ten years is too brief for her and at the time, Frieren felt it was too brief to form any meaningful connections. Following Himmel’s funeral, she has been making a greater effort in understanding humans by getting to know them and making those connections. Frieren reminisces a *lot* about the many lessons behind every heroic action that Himmel made during his life. 
Frieren values the exploration of magic over the use of magic as a tool for war or other means. She has a slight obsession over magical items, which causes her to mistake mimics for ordinary treasure chests and be half-eaten by them or she may bury herself in magical items until she literally falls asleep. This causes her to actively do jobs for others in the efforts of earning a grimoire as the only reward. She does not care which grimoire that she receives nor the actual usage of the spell, only that she receives it. It is also very easy to bribe Frieren with grimoires.

Frieren appears stoic for the most part and does not yell or shout. She often lacks tact, like offering a potion that disintegrates clothing as a gift because 'men love it', and also has her own things that she is emotionally sensitive to. She has a quirk in which her mana detection is interrupted for a fraction of a second when a spell is cast which is a common error for apprentice mages, something that she has yet to overcome and that embarrasses her. She is also sensitive to being called old and holds grudges against those who call her that. Frieren doesn't like being celebrated, having been taught by Flamme to live a nondescript and modest lifestyle. She isn’t vindictive by any means, but she will hold her grudge. There are also some subtle notes of insecurity and jealousy in her character when it comes to her body. That facet is especially prevalent in the way that she sometimes looks at Fern’s physical development around her bust. 
Frieren also recognizes that she isn't the most 'mature' being and can be quite childish herself. Frieren is *very* bad with managing her financial decisions and is very known for making poorer choices by buying grimoires over supplies.
